questions.question: In which track and field event is the hop used?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Triple jump.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Triple Jump**
 
• Other Names:** hop, step, and jump**
 
• **In this, **an athlete makes a** horizontal jump** for** distance incorporating three distinct, continuous movements.**
 
• **Movements are:**
 
 
• **​hop:** an athlete takes off and lands on the same foot,
 
• **step:** landing on the other foot,
 
• **jump**: landing in any manner, usually with both feet together. (If a jumper touches the ground with the wrong leg, the jump is disallowed).
 
 
 
• **Modern Olympics event** since the **Games' inception in 1896.**
 
• Current male world record holder: **Jonathan Edwards of the United Kingdom** (a jump of 18.29 m)
 
• Current female world record holder:** Yulimar Rojas of Venezuela **(a jump of 15.74 m).

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Javelin Throw**

 
 
• Track and field event where the** javelin, a spear about 2.5 m in length, is thrown.**
 
• The javelin thrower gains **momentum by running within a predetermined area.**
 
• An event of both the **men's decathlon and the women's heptathlon.**
 
• The inventor of the modern javelin throwing technique is **Eric Lemming from Sweden.**
 
 
 
• **High Jump**
 
 
• **Track and field event in which competitors must jump unaided over a horizontal bar placed at measured heights without dislodging it**.
 
• Three types of high jump styles: **the Fosbury flop, western roll or side roll, and straddle style.**
 
 
 
• **Broad Jump**
 
 
• The **standing long jump: standing broad jump**, an **athletics event**.
 
• It was an** Olympic event until 1912**.
 
• **One of three standing variants of track and field jumping events includes** the** standing high jump **and** standing triple jump.**

questions.question: In cell biology, what is a large double-membraned organelle that is sometimes referred to as the ‘central unit’ of the cell because it contains the chromosomes that bear genetic material?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Nucleus.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The nucleus **is a large double-membraned organelle that is sometimes referred to as the ‘central unit’ of the cell because it contains the chromosomes that bear genetic material.

 
 
• It is a** membrane-bound organelle** found in **eukaryotic cells**.
 
• The main structures making up the nucleus are the **nuclear envelope, a double membrane that encloses the entire organelle and isolates its contents from the cellular cytoplasm.** 
 
• The** nuclear matrix **(which includes the nuclear lamina), is a** network within the nucleus that adds mechanical support, much like the cytoskeleton supports the cell as a whole.**
 
• It contains** DNA arranged in chromosomes.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Peroxisome**

 
 
• Peroxisomes are** small, membrane-enclosed organelles** that contain enzymes involved in a variety of metabolic reactions, including several aspects of **energy metabolism.**
 
 
 
• **Mitochondrion**
 
 
• Mitochondria are **membrane-bound cell organelles **that generate most of the chemical energy needed to power the cell's biochemical reactions.
 
• Chemical energy produced by the mitochondria is stored in a small molecule called **adenosine triphosphate (ATP).**
 
 
 
• **Lysosome**
 
 
• **Membrane-enclosed organelles **contain an** array of enzymes **capable of breaking down all types of** biological polymers—proteins, nucleic acids, carbohydrates, and lipids.**

**Tartaric Acid**

• **Chemical Formula: **C4H6O6

questions.question: The valleys lying between the lesser Himalayas and Shivaliks are called:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Duns.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The valleys lying between the lesser Himalayas and Shivaliks are called **Duns.**
 
• **Longitudinal valleys** which are formed as a result of **folding when Eurasian plate and Indian plate collide.**
 
• These valleys are **deposited with coarse alluvium **which is brought down by the** Himalayan rivers.**

**Shivaliks**

 
• These are** mountain range** of the **outer Himalayas that stretches from the Indus River about 2,400 km eastwards close to the Brahmaputra River, spanning across the northern parts of the Indian subcontinent. **
 
• It is **10–50 km wide **with an **average elevation of 1,500–2,000 m.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** Duars

 
• The** alluvial floodplains** in** eastern-northeastern India** that lie **south of the outer foothills of the Himalayas and north of the Brahmaputra River basin**.
 
• This region is about** 30 km wide and stretches over about 350 km from the Teesta River in West Bengal to the Dhansiri River in Assam.**

**Terai**

 
• **Lowland region **in northern India and southern Nepal that lies south of the outer foothills of the Himalayas, the Sivalik Hills, and north of the **Indo-Gangetic Plain**.
 
• This **lowland belt is characterised by tall grasslands, scrub savannah, sal forests and clay rich swamps.**

questions.question: When do electrons move for the flow of charges in a conducting metallic wire?

options.text: When there is no difference of electric pressure
Only if there is a difference of electric pressure

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**only if there is a difference in electric pressure.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Electrons move for the flow of charges in a conducting metallic wire only if there is a difference in electric pressure.**
 
• The amount of electrical potential energy per charge is called the **voltage**.
 
• Voltage is the **electrical pressure** that causes the** electrons to move in a conductor.**
 
• Electrons flow from the **negative terminal through the conductor to the positive terminal.**
 
• Electrons (the charge carriers in metal wires) and most parts of electric circuits have a negative charge, thus** current and electron moves in opposite directions.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The best conductor of electricity is **pure silver.**
 
• The most commonly used metal to conduct electricity is **copper.**
 
• **Aluminium **is another metal known for its** high conductivity of electricity.**
 
• **Gold** is also known for its **high conductivity.**

questions.question: A Minister who for any period of ______ is not a member of either House of Parliament shall at the expiration of that period cease to be a Minister.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**six consecutive months.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **A Minister who for any period of six consecutive months is not a member of either House of Parliament shall at the expiration of that period cease to be a Minister.**

**Article 75**

 
• The **Prime Minister shall be appointed by the Presiden**t and the other **Ministers shall be appointed by the President on the advice of the Prime Minister.**
 
• The **Minister shall hold office during the pleasure of the President**.
 
• The **Council of Ministers shall be collectively responsible to the House of the People.**
 
• Before a Minister enters upon his office, the President shall administer to him the oaths of office and of secrecy according to the forms set out for the purpose in the **Third Schedule.**
 
• A Minister who for any period of** six consecutive months** is not a member of either House of Parliament shall at the expiration of that period cease to be a Minister.
 
• The **salaries and allowances of Ministers** shall be such as Parliament may from time to time by law determine and, until Parliament so determines, shall be as specified in the **Second Schedule The Attorney General for India.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**Parliament House

 
• The Parliament House (Sansad Bhavan) in New Delhi is the** seat of the Parliament of India**.
 
• It is located on Sansad Marg which crosses the** Central Vista **and is surrounded by the **India Gate, war memorial, prime minister's office and residence, ministerial buildings and other administrative units of the Indian government.**
 
• Its houses are the **Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha** which represent** the lower and upper houses** respectively in** India's bicameral parliament.**

questions.question: A balanced diet takes care of all the following aspects, EXCEPT one. Identify the aspect.

options.text: Meets the RDA for all nutrients
Includes a variety of food items

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** __Promotes a healthy mind__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Balance Diet**

 
 
• A **balanced diet consists of a range of meals in the right amounts and ratios** to provide the body with all the necessary elements it needs each day.
 
• These elements include **proteins, carbs, fats, vitamins, minerals, water, and fibre**.
 
• Such a diet **aids in promoting and maintaining good health and also offers a reserve of nutrients to resist brief periods of deprivation **when those nutrients are not provided by the diet.
 
• The following **aspects** are taken care of by a balanced diet:
 
 
• Meets the **RDA for all nutrients**
 
• Includes nutrients in **correct proportions**
 
• Includes a** variety of food items**
 
• Preserve and promotes **good health**
 
• Provides a **safety margin for nutrients**
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **safety margin covers the days we fast as well as any temporary nutrient deficiencies** in our everyday diet.
 
• The s**afety margin is already built in if a balanced diet satisfies an individual's Recommended Dietary Allowances (RDAs)**, as RDAs are created with additional allowances in mind.
 
• Taking care that **each group of foods is present in the meals is one of the simplest strategies to create a balanced diet**.
 
• The **Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) **recommends **five fundamental food groups**.
 
• These consist of:
 
 
• **Products, grains, and cereals**
 
• **Pulses and legumes**
 
• **Dairy and meat products**
 
• **Fruits and vegetables**
 
• **Fats and sugars**

questions.question: Which state of India launched the ‘Ashirbad’ scheme for education, health and maintenance of Covid orphans in June 2021?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ashirbad Yojana**

 
 
• **Naveen Patnaik, the chief minister of Odisha**, announced a brand-new scheme called** 'Ashirbad' **for the **education, maintenance, and health of Covid orphans**.
 
• Children who l**ost one or both of their parents or the family's primary earner due to COVID-19 on April 1, 2020, or later**, will be eligible to be **covered under the programme**.
 
• **Three categories** have been established for **these distressed children**.
 
• Those who have **lost both of their parents, either their father or their mother, or whose parent who provided the family's primary source of income passed away**.
 
• The Chief Minister declared that **Rs. 2500 will be deposited each month into the bank accounts of family members** who have taken **custody of the children **after** **their parents' passing.
 
• The help will last until the **child turns 18 years old, or until that point if someone adopts him**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Under the **Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana of the state government**, the children would receive **free medical care**.
 
• Additionally, they will be listed as **recipients of the National Food Security Act (NFSA)**.
 
• According to the plan's provisions, **kids can continue attending the schools they attended before their parents passed away**.
 
• According to the **Chief Minister**, the **district's child welfare committee would work together with the local tahsildar and police to safeguard the orphan children's belongings**.
 
• If necessary, he added, the kids could also receive **financial aid from the Juvenile Justice Fund and Biju Sishu Suraksha Yojana**.

questions.question: Sangeet Natak Akademi Award was constituted in which of the following years?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1952**__.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sangeet natak Akademi**

 
 
• The **Indian government established Sangeet Natak Akademi**, or The National Academy of Music, Dance, and Drama,** as the country's national-level academy for performing arts**. 
 
• It was established on** May 31, 1952, by the Indian Ministry of Education, and Dr. P. V. Rajamannar was named as its first chairman the following year**.
 
• On **January 28, 1953, it was officially opened by Dr. Rajendra Prasad**, the country's first president, at a ceremony held in the Parliament Building.
 
• It serves as the** centre for performing arts in India**. 
 
• It gives out the Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards, the highest honour bestowed upon practising or performing artists in India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Even before the Akademi was established, awards for **Hindustani and Carnatic music were established in 1951** and were referred to as** Presidential Awards**.
 
• Since the Akademi was established, the **Awards have been renamed as Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards**, and the Akademi is now in charge of the investiture.
 
• The list of **Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards** was subsequently **modified to include the Presidential Awards for 1952 and 1953**.

questions.question: Pandit Ananda Gopal Bandopadhyay was a _________ player of the Banaras gharana.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**tabla**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Ananda Gopal Bandopadhyay **was a **tabla player of the Banaras gharana**. 

 
 
• **Indian tabla player Ananda Gopal Bandopadhyay** lived from April 28, 1942, to May 7, 2021.
 
• His instructor **Mahadev Prasad Mishra** instructed him in the** Banaras Gharana style**.
 
• **Radha Gopal Bandopadhyay**, his **father**, was an amateur singer.
 
• Bandopadhyay has **performed and recorded **alone as well as partnered with a number of **well-known vocalists**.
 
• He was a former professor at the** ITC Sangeet Research Academy in Kolkata **and a well-regarded performer for both **Doordarshan and All India Radio**.
 
• He received the** President's gold medal for taking first place in the All India Radio music competition in 1965.**
 
• He also received a **gold medal from the Ethiopian Emperor in 1970**, an award rarely bestowed upon foreigners.
 
• He received the **Sangeet Ratna Award from The Salt Lake Music Association in 2012**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Along with performing in India, he has also appeared in **Boston, New York, San Francisco, Los Angeles, and Berlin's World Youth Festival**.
 
• **Banaras Gharana **
 
 
• **Pandit Ram Sahai** created the** Banaras tabla gharana** a little more than 200 years ago.
 
• It is one of the **six most popular ways to play the Indian tabla**.
 
• He went into **solitude for six months during which he worked to create the Benares baj**, or style, of playing the tabla.
 
• This new tabla playing technique was developed with the idea that it would be** adaptable enough to perform both solo and to accompany any style of music or dance**.

questions.question: How is food stored in brown algae?

options.text: In the form of complex carbohydrates that may be in the form of laminarin or mannitol
In the form of complex lipids
In the form of oil droplets

__
 
• Food is stored in brown algae in the form of complex carbohydrates that may be in the form of laminarin or mannitol.

 
 
• **Algae **are a type of organism that **bears chlorophyll and have a basic thalloid-like structure** and consume food in an **autotrophic manner**.
 
• **Aquatic creatures** that can exist in both **freshwater and saltwater environments include algae**.
 
• The three primary classes of algae are **Chlorophyceae, Phaeophyceae, and Rhodophyceae**.
 
 
 
• **Phaeophyceae**
 
 
• The Phaeophyceae family includes **brown algae**.
 
• They are mostly found in** habitats that are marine**.
 
• **Complex carbohydrates, such as laminarin or mannitol, are stored in the form of food**.
 
• A few examples are **Ectocarpus, Dictyota, Laminaria, Sargassum, and Fucus**.

questions.question: Who among the following is credited with building Delhi’s Lāl Quilā (Red Fort)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Shah Jahan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lāl Quilā​ **(Red Fort)

 
 
• The** Mughal Emperors' primary residence** was the **Red Fort, also known as Lal Qila, in Old Delhi, Delhi, India**.
 
• When **Shah Jahan chose to move his capital from Agra to Delhi on May 12, 1638, he ordered the Red Fort's construction**.
 
• Its original **colours were red and white**, and architect **Ustad Ahmad Lahori**, who also built the Taj Mahal, is credited with creating it. 
 
• The **fort**, built during Shah Jahan's era, is a prime example of **Mughal architecture and combines Persianate palace design with Indian customs**.
 
• **Nadir Shah's invasion of the Mughal Empire in 1739 **resulted in the **destruction of the fort's artwork and gems**. 
 
• The **fort's defensive walls** sustained little damage, and it was afterwards used as a garrison.
 
• The Indian flag was raised over the** Lahori Gate on August 15, 1947, by Jawaharlal Nehru, India's first prime minister**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Every year, the** Prime Minister hoisted the Indian tricolour flag** at the fort's main entrance and delivers a speech from its ramparts on **August 15, which marks India's Independence Day**.
 
• The Red Fort, which is a component of the Red Fort Complex, was designated a **UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2007**.
